title: Tiny, cute cactus in a pot
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <defs>
    <linearGradient id='potGrad' x1='0' y1='0' x2='1' y2='0'>
      <stop offset='0' stop-color='#c25a2e'/>
      <stop offset='0.5' stop-color='#e8763c'/>
      <stop offset='1' stop-color='#a84a24'/>
    </linearGradient>
    <linearGradient id='cactusGrad' x1='0' y1='0' x2='1' y2='0'>
      <stop offset='0' stop-color='#3fae4e'/>
      <stop offset='0.5' stop-color='#5fd06e'/>
      <stop offset='1' stop-color='#2e8f3c'/>
    </linearGradient>
    <linearGradient id='armGrad' x1='0' y1='0' x2='1' y2='0'>
      <stop offset='0' stop-color='#4cbf5a'/>
      <stop offset='1' stop-color='#2e8f3c'/>
    </linearGradient>
  </defs>

  <!-- pot rim -->
  <rect x='28' y='68' width='44' height='9' rx='3' fill='#f08a4b'/>
  <rect x='28' y='68' width='44' height='4' rx='2' fill='#ffb07a'/>

  <!-- pot body -->
  <path d='M31 77 L69 77 L64 92 Q50 96 36 92 Z' fill='url(#potGrad)'/>
  <path d='M33 77 L67 77 L65.5 81 L34.5 81 Z' fill='#f4925a' opacity='0.7'/>

  <!-- left arm -->
  <path d='M38 55 Q30 55 30 47 Q30 41 36 41 Q41 41 41 47 L41 55 Z' fill='url(#armGrad)'/>
  <path d='M33 44 Q35 43 37 45' stroke='#8be89a' stroke-width='1.2' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>

  <!-- right arm -->
  <path d='M62 50 Q70 50 70 42 Q70 36 64 36 Q59 36 59 42 L59 50 Z' fill='url(#armGrad)'/>
  <path d='M64 39 Q66 38 67 41' stroke='#8be89a' stroke-width='1.2' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>

  <!-- main cactus body -->
  <rect x='38' y='24' width='24' height='46' rx='12' fill='url(#cactusGrad)'/>
  <!-- highlight -->
  <rect x='43' y='29' width='6' height='35' rx='3' fill='#a3f0ad' opacity='0.55'/>

  <!-- ribs/spines -->
  <g stroke='#d8ffd9' stroke-width='0.9' stroke-linecap='round' opacity='0.85'>
    <path d='M50 30 L50 33'/>
    <path d='M45 40 L45 43'/>
    <path d='M55 40 L55 43'/>
    <path d='M45 52 L45 55'/>
    <path d='M55 52 L55 55'/>
    <path d='M50 46 L50 49'/>
    <path d='M50 60 L50 63'/>
    <path d='M44 64 L44 67'/>
    <path d='M56 64 L56 67'/>
  </g>

  <!-- flower on top -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='21' r='4.5' fill='#ff6fa5'/>
  <circle cx='45.5' cy='23' r='3.2' fill='#ff9cc0'/>
  <circle cx='54.5' cy='23' r='3.2' fill='#ff9cc0'/>
  <circle cx='50' cy='21' r='2' fill='#ffe066'/>
  <circle cx='50' cy='21' r='0.9' fill='#ffb347'/>
</svg>
